title: merge reports failed for a merged code branch that has more than one merge request, since glab mr view refuses the branch
goal: backlog.py merge reads the state of code/ID's merge request even when the branch has more than one (glab mr view BRANCH exits 1 with You must select a merge request): it falls back to the branch's requests (glab mr list --source-branch BRANCH --all, newest first), reports one already merged as merged with exit 0 and merges only an open one, so a re-pushed branch whose old request was closed is not reported failed after its new request merged. Found by the SP-hyp6o7hl review.
